parakeet: We're advanced enough to put rovers on Mars, but we still don't require basic comprehension tests from those we trust with budgets, bodies, and rights. That gap is the problem. The fix isn't louder faith. It's humbler methods. Gratitude can stay. Community can stay, but certainty has to earn its place. Until then, superstition wearing a lab coat or a flag is still superstition, and it has no business running your life or your country.
